title: 492. Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in an Array

examples.explanation: 5 XOR 25 equals 28, and no pair reaches a larger value.
Some pair in the list XORs to 127, which is the best achievable score.

hints: Think bit by bit from the most significant position downward, keeping the set of prefixes seen so far.
A binary trie of the numbers lets you greedily walk toward the opposite bit at each level.
Trying to build the answer greedily works: check whether a candidate prefix pattern is attainable from pairs of number prefixes.
